concepts.hook_line_ko: 비가 오는데 손님이 끊이지 않는다. 그런데 그는 자꾸 집 쪽을 돌아본다.
concepts.why_this_book_ko: 원작의 긴장이 사건이 아니라 시선과 망설임에 있어서 대사 없이 그림만으로 전달된다. '왜 돌아보는가'는 구체적이고 메울 수 있다고 느껴지는 격차이며, 15초 안에 닫지 않고 남긴다 — 도서 발견 앱에서는 결말을 닫지 않는 편이 읽기로 이어진다.
제목 자체가 아이러니라 설명이 필요 없다. 기각 이유: 제목의 반전을 첫 3초에 써버려 시청자가 스스로 알아챌 여지를 없애고, 실사는 인물 일관성 유지가 어렵다.

concepts.hook_line_ko: 그는 설렁탕을 사 들고 집 문을 열었다.
concepts.why_this_book_ko: 가장 유명한 문장을 그대로 쓴다. 기각 이유: 결말 직전 장면이라 스포일러 위험이 셋 중 가장 크다 — 문을 여는 순간을 훅으로 쓰면 남는 것은 결말뿐이다.

style_lock: monochrome ink line art, thin clean strokes, heavy rain drawn as fine diagonal hatching, deep black shadows, no color
character_sheet: a wiry Korean man in his forties, weathered hollow-cheeked face, thin moustache, soaked traditional jeogori jacket and baji trousers, a cloth towel knotted around his head, worn straw sandals

shots.description: a rickshaw puller running through a rain-soaked 1920s Seoul street, a passenger seated behind him under a canopy, his head turned back over his shoulder toward the alley he came from
shots.sfx: heavy rain drumming on the rickshaw canvas and straw sandals slapping through puddles

shots.description: the same man standing motionless at a crowded crossroads in the rain, one hand closed around a heavy fistful of coins, everyone else moving past him while he stares down a narrow alley toward a small tiled-roof house with its door shut
shots.sfx: rain, cart wheels on stone, and the low murmur of a market street

shots.description: a close view from behind of the man standing at the closed door of the small house, both hands cradling a wrapped earthenware bowl still steaming in the cold rain, his hand raised toward the door but not touching it
shots.sfx: the rain thinning to isolated drips, and complete silence from inside the house

overall_soundscape: Continuous heavy rain on canvas, wet stone and roof tiles throughout. Straw sandals slapping through puddles, cart wheels, and the low murmur of a market crowd across the middle section. In the final seconds the rain thins to isolated drips and the street noise falls away, leaving near silence at the door.
non_diegetic_music: A single low daegeum flute holding one long breathy note, joined near the middle by sparse janggu drum taps at about 54 BPM. The drum stops entirely in the last three seconds and the flute fades without resolving.
